title: 18 November 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 112th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date. They topped a bill which also featured The Merseybeats and Paul Hartigan’s Jazz Band.

This was billed as a ‘Welcome Home’ night following their second residency at the Star-Club in Hamburg. Overall this was the group’s 255th appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including the lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
